newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy minister denies report of pensions freeze.
newsitem.headline: Italy minister denies report of pensions freeze.

text.p: Civil Service Minister Franco Bassanini denied on Tuesday a report that the government was studying the possibility of freezing early retirement by civil servants for a year.
"There is no truth to this at all," he told Italian television.

The economic daily Il Sole 24-Ore reported that in order to cut spending the government was looking into the possibility of freezing early retirement requests by public employees with less that 30 years of social security contributions. -- Rome newsroom +396 678-2501
